checked_claims.note: RH gives 18 simple branches; C_18 has stack dimension 18-3=15 with PGL_2 already quotiented. Branch map of the simply branched Hurwitz stack to the configuration stack is classically finite etale onto its image (local tame model y^2=t); the writeup is a sketch but the conclusion is standard and correct. Connected transposition monodromy forces S_4 hence primitivity; deck group is the center of S_4, hence trivial; residual autos inject into Aut(P^1, branch set), finite and generically trivial. Balanced and W^2_5-free are open, so each nonempty component B is smooth of pure dimension 15 with finite/generically trivial stabilizers. Addresses FND-0060.

Dual-confirmed CLM-0066-2/3 give h^0(L)∈{3,4} under weak CE with B_4 contained in the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus (one-way). Simple branching forces primitivity, so B∩B_4 is empty and h^0=3 constantly on B. Smooth B is reduced, so CLM-0066-4 applies: I is a relative P^2-bundle. Does not claim emptiness of B_4 on the full balanced (non-simply-branched) locus.

Basepoint p of |L| yields h^0(L(-p))=3, deg 5, χ=0, h^1=3; weak CE + Serre gives h^0(O(D+p))=3, a forbidden g^2_5 on U. Char-0 Bertini on a basepoint-free system on a smooth geometric curve makes the discriminant proper closed in each P^2-fibre, so I^{dist} is dense nonempty in every fibre. Relative P^2 over irreducible B implies I and its dense open I^{dist} are irreducible of dimension 17. Honest repair of FND-0083 on this open; does not use bare χ(L)=1.

Stack-level finite etale S_6-torsor and Conf_6 scheme identification inherited from dual-confirmed CLM-0066-6 within ordered distinct-section scope (FND-0064/0075/0087). Finite etale preserves pure dimension 17. Over a geometrically connected base, right S_6-translation acts transitively on monodromy orbits of a geometric fibre, hence on connected components. Number of components correctly left open (GAP-COMP-3).

Under weak CE, O(D)=ω(-Γ) has h^0=h^0(L)-χ(L)=2, so |D| is the unique complete residual g^1_4 and recovers γ up to Aut(P^1); geometric fibres of psi have at most one isomorphism class. Ordered pointed autos fix Γ hence preserve O(D) and act on H^0(O(D)), lifting uniquely to cover autos; converse is forgetful. Geometric Aut isomorphism implies inertia mono for DM stacks, hence representability by algebraic spaces; finite geometric fibres then give quasi-finiteness. For finite-type pure-dimensional DM sources, quasi-finite maps send component dimensions to dimensions of image closures: 17, and codim 21-17=4 in M_{6,6}. Full faithfulness on arbitrary T-points, closedness, and lci are correctly not claimed (GAP-COMP-4). Closures are not claimed to be components of the full CE-failure locus (GAP-COMP-5; FND-0052).

Pure specialization of dual-confirmed CLM-0066-6/ATT-0048 Fitting=Abel–Jacobi ideal equality on Conf_6 with six ordered disjoint sections. Scope matches the ordered distinct-support open of this theorem; no extension to nonreduced Hilbert incidence outside Conf_6.

finding_candidates.statement: Every connected simply branched degree-four cover of P^1 has monodromy S_4 (transposition graph of a connected degree-4 cover is connected, hence generates S_4) and is therefore primitive. Combined with the one-way containment B_4⊂{hyperelliptic non-primitive covers} under weak CE (ATT-0066/CLM-0066-3), one has h^0(L)=3 constantly on every nonempty open of the simply branched balanced Hurwitz stack; in particular the h^0=4 jump stratum is empty on H^{sb,bal}. This discharges GAP-H0-1 on the simply branched locus without settling emptiness of B_4 for non-simply-branched balanced covers.

finding_candidates.statement: On any geometric fibre of the balanced CE residual system with weak CE normalization L≅ω_C(-D) and W^2_5(C)=∅, the complete system |L| is basepoint-free: a basepoint p would force h^0(O_C(D+p))=3 by RR+Serre, i.e. a g^2_5. In characteristic zero the discriminant in |L|≅P^{h^0-1} is then a proper closed subset, so the reduced-support open is dense and nonempty in every such fibre. Thus χ(L)=1 is not needed for reduced-support nonemptiness on the W^2_5-free open.

finding_candidates.statement: The Hurwitz stack of connected simply branched degree-four genus-6 covers is a smooth DM stack of pure dimension 15=18-3 (branch configuration stack dimension after PGL_2), with finite stabilizers and trivial generic stabilizer: deck transformations vanish because the monodromy is S_4 with trivial centralizer, and residual automorphisms inject into the finite (generically trivial) group Aut(P^1, eighteen distinct branch points). The balanced open inherits the same dimension and stabilizer conclusions.

finding_candidates.statement: Under weak CE normalization on the ordered distinct-support incidence tilde I over a simply branched balanced W^2_5-free base component of dimension 15, the residual formula O_C(D)=ω_C(-Γ) recovers a unique complete g^1_4 from the marked divisor, the geometric stabilizer map Aut(C,γ,p_i)→Aut(C,p_i) is an isomorphism, and the classifying morphism psi: tilde I→M_{6,6} is representable and quasi-finite. Consequently each irreducible component of tilde I has image closure of dimension 17 and codimension 4 in M_{6,6}. This is a mono/quasi-finiteness statement for the ordered model only and does not identify those closures as irreducible components of the full CE-failure locus.

strongest_attack: Strongest attack: that step 1’s branch-morphism étaleness is only a local slogan (y^2=t; ‘glue uniquely away from the etale locus’ is nearly circular) and that geometric-point Aut(C,γ,p_i)≅Aut(C,p_i) does not supply stack representability or a stack-level quasi-finite dimension theorem for dim(closure psi(component))=17, so CLM-0070-1 and CLM-0070-5 are under-proved and the codimension-4 image claim collapses. Outcome: does not refute the stated theorem. (i) Finite étaleness of the simply branched Hurwitz branch map onto its image in the configuration stack is classical in char 0; dim=b-3=15 already builds in PGL_2, and the transposition-graph monodromy / centralizer / Aut(P^1,B) stabilizer analysis correctly upgrades the coarse count to a DM stack of pure dimension 15 with finite and generically trivial stabilizers (the FND-0060 repair). (ii) For Deligne–Mumford stacks, geometric-point inertia injectivity is the standard representability criterion; finite geometric fibres then give quasi-finiteness; for finite-type pure-dimensional DM sources the fibre-dimension theorem yields dim(image closure)=17 and codim 4 in M_{6,6} without properness or closed image. Full faithfulness on arbitrary T-points is correctly left open (GAP-COMP-4) and is not required. Secondary attacks: weak CE is the sole engine of pencil recovery and Aut lifting—correctly an explicit hypothesis (FND-0105/0098); Bertini and residual g^2_5 basepoint-freeness check out in char 0 on U; scheme-theoretic tilde I=Z_ev is pure dual-confirmed inheritance on Conf_6 (FND-0046 scope). Checklist items on BM vs ordinary degree, Poincaré/Tate twists, Gysin/Künneth, spectral-sequence differentials, graph Aut invariants/coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted motives, pure-Tate upgrades, and omitted stable pairs do not engage this pure-geometry lemma.
theorem_statement: Let k be a characteristic-zero field and let H^{sb,bal} be the Hurwitz stack of connected simply branched degree-four covers gamma:C→P^1 with C smooth of genus 6 and balanced Casnati–Ekedahl relations bundle F≅O(4)⊕O(5). Assume the weak CE relative-canonical normalization, so on geometric fibres L:=W_5⊗omega_C^{-1}≅omega_C(-D), where D is a fibre of gamma. Let U⊂H^{sb,bal} be the open where W^2_5(C)=empty, and let B be any nonempty irreducible component of U. Let I→B be the Abel–Jacobi incidence of effective degree-six divisors Gamma with O_C(Gamma)≅L, let I^{dist} be its distinct-support open, and let tilde I→I^{dist} order the six support points. Then: (1) B is smooth of pure dimension 15, has finite stabilizers, and has trivial generic stabilizer. (2) h^0(L)=3 on B, I is a relative P^2-bundle, |L| is fibrewise basepoint-free, and I^{dist} is dense and nonempty in every geometric fibre. Thus I^{dist} is irreducible of dimension 17. (3) tilde I→I^{dist} is a finite etale S_6-torsor on stacks; every irreducible component of tilde I has dimension 17, and over a geometrically connected base the S_6-action is transitive on its connected components. (4) For the classifying morphism psi:tilde I→M_{6,6}, the pencil is recovered from the marked divisor by O_C(D)=omega_C(-Gamma) and gamma=|D|. Consequently psi is representable and quasi-finite, and Aut(C,gamma,p_1,...,p_6)→Aut(C,p_1,...,p_6) is an isomorphism at every geometric point. The closure of the image of each irreducible component of tilde I therefore has dimension 17 and codimension 4 in M_{6,6}. In the ordered distinct-section scope, tilde I is scheme-theoretically the balanced CE evaluation-failure locus supplied by ATT-0066. No assertion is made that these closures are components of the full CE-failure locus.
